name: Ru Kiln
ability: Once per round, when you complete any Order using a Celadon, Plain Masterpiece, gain 4 VP.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你用1件青釉、素面珍品完成任意订单时，获得4分。

name: Guan Kiln
ability: Once per round, when you complete an Imperial Order, gain 2 Coins and 1 VP. You may also ignore one Decoration requirement on that Order.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成1张御用订单时，获得2铜钱和1分，并且可以独立选择忽略该订单上的1项装饰要求。

name: Ge Kiln
ability: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, spend 1 Wood, then choose one of your ceramics whose Actual Heat differs from its Preferred Heat by 1 or 2. Set its Actual Heat equal to its Preferred Heat and change its Decoration to Crackle without paying the Crackle cost.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在计算实际火候后、判定品第之前，花费1柴薪，然后选择你1件实际火候与适温相差1或2的器物。将其实际火候设为等于适温，并将其装饰改为开片，无需支付开片费用。

name: Ding Kiln
ability: Once per round, when resolving the Forming Studio, after you shape a Bowl, Plate or Washer, you may shape one additional vessel of the same Shape at no Clay cost. This additional vessel does not count against the action's normal limit.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在结算制坯坊时，于你制作1件碗、盘或洗之后，可免付陶土费用再制作1件相同器形的坯体。此额外坯体不计入该行动的正常上限。

name: Jun Kiln
ability: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, you may pay 1 Wood to adjust the Actual Heat of one of your ceramics by +1 or -1.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在计算实际火候后、判定品第之前，可支付1柴薪，将你1件器物的实际火候调整+1或-1。
